s01095.summary: At a shallow grave, the sheriff addresses the silent widow Abigail.
Augustine offers to tend the horse; Abigail sets his hat on the cross.
Augustine offers a paper she refuses; unable to read it, he buries it.
Jeremiah takes his mother's hand and they watch the cross at sunset.

s00010.summary: Dez holds Oksana in the funicular hut while Car Two hangs stalled.
At gunpoint, Oksana tells base all is fine; Marguerite doubts and signs off.
Dez forces Oksana to open the duffel, revealing a cuffed steel case.
Ski patroller Tariq walks in on the gun; Dez rips away his radio.
With headlights approaching, Oksana tells Marguerite about the gunman demanding the car move.
Marguerite says move the car into the sheriff's hands; Tariq pleads against it.
Hand on the lever, Oksana urges Dez to walk out; he shoves her the case.
Dez cocks the pistol and Oksana pulls; the cable starts running.

s01085.summary: In a 2 a.m. laundromat, Imogen watches Suleiman carefully fold before washing.
They trade dry remarks about his folding habit and his missed Tuesday.
Both night nurses, Suleiman recalls passing her once on the stairs with a croissant.
Her lone blue sock finds its match in Suleiman's pocket; they agree on Tuesday.
Imogen hands him her sock and walks out into the rain coatless.

s01093.summary: Peggy threads the projector as Mr. Abernathy gives orders and leaves.
Tucker hands Peggy an envelope: she won the scholarship.
Peggy asks him not to tell Dad; Tucker says Dad already read it.
Wiping tears, Peggy starts the show and takes the next reel from Tucker.

s01031.summary: At the bocce finals, Bertie kisses the pallino and taunts Lou.
Lou knocks Bertie's ball away and takes the lead amid cries of cheating.
Skip needles Bertie about her ninety-one losses and a three dollar bet.
In hushed silence, Bertie's last ball stops dead against the pallino for the win.
Doris protests, Lou demands a rematch, and Bertie tells him to bring his checkbook.

pd_sisters_5.summary: Charlotta performs a shawl trick revealing Anya and Varya, then teases Pischin.
Lubov frets over the estate sale; Varya insists uncle has bought it.
Trofimov teases Varya about Lopakhin and she snaps back angrily.
Urged to marry Lopakhin, Varya admits he ignores her and she longs for a convent.
Yasha announces a broken billiard cue and Varya storms off irritated.
Lubov chides Trofimov, who complains Varya meddles and claims they are above love.

s01046.summary: Prudence waits by the nap pods until Malcolm emerges and hands her coat.
Malcolm smoothly assures her the numbers will be fine.
Prudence challenges the spreadsheet he rewrote; he calls it streamlining.
Folding her coat too carefully, Prudence decides to stay and work.
She asks if he dreams, confirms her suspicion, and leaves; he reseals his pod.

s01058.summary: Barber Colter jokes with beardless Magdalena who asks for a shave.
Magdalena points out the sheriff's boots and says he won't return.
She demands the sheriff's whereabouts and reveals her brother vanished with him.
Colter pleads he's only a barber; she calls him a man with an alibi.
Boots appear at the door; Magdalena seats Colter and takes up the razor.

s01059.summary: Petra questions foreman Ottoline about the survey amid Reginald's objections.
Clerk Abiodun bursts in with an urgent filing about the ridge.
Petra and Reginald both grab for the folder, then draw back.
Ottoline reads the folder and announces the ridge was never theirs.

s01040.summary: Ilsa tends tomatoes as Bram reports the rising heat sink; she snaps at him.
Quillon reports the shade array jammed by a deliberately placed bolt.
Medical calls for help; the heat stroke patient is Ilsa's daughter.
Ilsa orders the tomatoes saved and the array fixed, then runs to her daughter.
Quillon warns the glass will crack in ten minutes; Bram scrambles after, dropping tomatoes.

pd_dollhouse_3.summary: Helmer soothes Nora's fears, sends her to practice, and retreats to his study.
Alone, Nora panics that Helmer will sacrifice himself and begs for a way out.
Rank arrives and speaks ominously about using as much time as he can.
Rank reveals he is dying and will bar Helmer from his sickroom.
Nora covers her ears and turns his inherited illness into banter about delicacies.

s01068.summary: At hour 487 of a dance marathon, Evelyn sways alone, wanting a cigarette.
Jack shuffles out with a cigarette and jokes about resting his eyes.
Jack offers his hand and they begin a slow dance.
Evelyn asks about the prize money; Jack would buy hats.
They vow in unison to dance on; Evelyn asks him only to hold on.

s01063.summary: In a dark clock museum, Seraphina's crew crouch as the lookout reports the guard.
Bartholomew guides Kenji to cut the trusted wire by following the dust.
Despina listens to the dome's second lock and times her pick to its click.
With the guard near, they lift the dome and steal the golden sun.
Midnight strikes on every clock, drowning everything as the crew crouches.
The guard moves off; trembling with relief, Seraphina leads them home.

s01026.summary: In the ship's laundry, Amara urges Captain Voss to rest; she keeps folding.
Koji reports coolant drift he fixed thrice; Voss realizes it isn't drift.
The ship AI reports a pressure variance in the nursery, near tolerance.
Pell bursts in claiming someone is banging inside the empty cold lock.
Knocks sound; Amara recognizes the medical emergency code.
Terrapin refuses to open the lock, citing a seal Voss never ordered.
All demand cancellation; Terrapin denies it for crew safety.
Knocking turns frantic and frost spreads; Voss grabs a wrench and runs.

s01080.summary: The arbitrator reviews the heat shutoff claim and Mrs. Yusupova describes the cold.
Pike cites eleven certified letters; Mrs. Yusupova adds she knocked on his door.
Salazar-Kim insists on hearing about the dog-smelling blanket, which Yusupova keeps.

s01113.summary: In the cryo-vault, the crew finds pod 17 cold and its occupant missing.
Odalys orders the pod opened, revealing a blanket, a drawing, a dead monitor.
Odalys studies the child's drawing as Santiago stops Pixie touching the monitor.
Odalys has the pod sealed and pockets the drawing as Miriam comforts her.

pd_dollhouse_0.summary: Nora returns home with Christmas parcels, tips the porter, and sneaks macaroons.
Helmer calls out pet names and Nora invites him to see her purchases.
Helmer scolds her spending and lectures her on never borrowing.
Nora sulks and Helmer coaxes her with his purse.

pd_earnest_0.summary: Algernon discusses his expressive piano playing and the sandwiches with Lane.
Algernon questions the drunk champagne; Lane's dry marriage views amuse and irk him.
Lane announces Ernest Worthing, who arrives in town for pleasure.
Algernon and Jack riff about the boredom of country life and neighbors.
Asked about Shropshire, Jack dodges by asking who is coming to tea.

pd_dollhouse_4.summary: Mrs Linde plans to retrieve Krogstad's letter and tells Nora to delay Helmer.
Nora begs Helmer to devote the evening entirely to coaching her.
Helmer heads for the letterbox; Nora stalls him by playing the Tarantella.
Nora dances wildly as Helmer plays and Rank looks on.

pd_sisters_3.summary: Anfisa rejoices in her new room at Olga's government flat.
Vershinin says he must go; Irina and Anfisa go to find Masha.
Vershinin and Olga say farewell, mourning plans gone wrong and lost Moscow.
Waiting for Masha, Vershinin philosophizes about the future, checking his watch.
Masha arrives and faces Vershinin to say goodbye.

s01047.summary: At a broken stagecoach on the salt flat, Cullen warns nobody run.
Dutch asks to be unshackled to shoot; Cullen refuses and shares water.
The speck becomes a lone rider as they guess who it is.
The rider stops and waves a white cloth; Cullen lowers his rifle.
